charter.project_overview: Apex Gear Co. is a Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) outdoor & performance e-commerce gear company operating across North America, Europe, and APAC with ~$15M in annual revenue. Over the past 2 quarters, executive leadership allocated a significant budget to scale marketing campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok. While top-line site traffic increased, Gross Revenue remained flat, and overall Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) surged by 28% YoY.
charter.overall_objective: Unify siloed data across ad platforms, web analytics, CRM, and e-commerce orders to evaluate true marketing performance against historical baselines. Specifically, analyze whether the expanded marketing investment increased or eroded overall Marketing ROI, identify performance shortfalls across channels, and establish a data-driven path forward to restore or surpass pre-scaling ROI efficiency through strategic budget reallocation.
charter.in_scope:
• Channels & Platforms: Performance analysis of paid digital channels (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads), GA4 web traffic, CRM lead pipelines, and Shopify e-commerce transactions across North America, Europe, and APAC regions.
• Core Metrics & ROI Analysis: Evaluation of historical marketing spend vs. pre-scaling baselines, Channel ROAS, Blended CAC, MER, Customer 12-Month LTV, and net margin contribution.
• Customer & Order Analysis: Cohort analysis based on first-purchase date, product category performance, discount impact, and return rates.
charter.out_of_scope:
• Real-Time Data Streaming: Analysis is based on a daily batch refresh schedule; real-time intra-day click/order streaming is excluded.
• Offline & Traditional Marketing: Physical store sales, print/TV advertising, and offline event attribution are excluded.
• Predictive ML Modeling: Advanced machine learning models (e.g., predictive churn or automated budget optimization algorithms) are excluded from this core stage.

• Automated Campaign Bid Execution: The system provides decision-support analytics and recommendations; it will not execute automated API write-backs to adjust live campaign budgets inside Meta or Google Ads.

process_flow.description: User views paid ad creative on social feed or search engine.
User clicks ad link and is redirected to Apex Gear online store.
User navigates catalog, views product detail pages, and adds items to cart.
User completes checkout payment and order is recorded.
process_flow.derived_metrics: Gross Order Value, Total Orders Count

process_flow.description: Order is processed, shipped, or returned by customer.
Customer engages in repeat purchases over a 12-month window.

risks.mitigation: Establish a unified base reporting currency (USD) in the Star Schema using daily static exchange rate tables for EU and APAC sales
Prioritize Blended CAC and MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio) as the executive primary metrics over single-platform reported ROAS

Prioritize Shopify order IDs as the absolute ground truth for revenue. Calculate Blended MER and Blended CAC at the executive level, using channel-reported revenue strictly for secondary tactical insights
Standardize and hash primary identifiers (customer_id, email) across GA4 web sessions, CRM leads, and Shopify sales tables during Power Query ETL
Utilize GA4 blended web data alongside server-side Shopify transaction records to bridge tracking gaps caused by iOS 14.5+ privacy opt-outs and ad blockers
Apply a daily static exchange rate table in the Star Schema to normalize EUR and APAC transactions into USD at the point of sale
Measure top-line performance using Net Revenue (Gross Revenue - Discounts - Returns) rather than raw platform-reported gross sales

kpis.business_definition: Calculates true realized top-line revenue after all promo deductions and returned goods
kpis.dax_formula: [Net Sales] = [Gross Order Value] - [Total Discount Amount] - [Total Return Amount]

kpis.business_definition: Evaluates return on ad spend at the isolated ad network level for tactical campaign optimization
kpis.dax_formula: [Channel ROAS] = DIVIDE([Channel Reported Revenue], [Total Ad Spend], 0)

kpis.business_definition: Executive North Star metric measuring total marketing efficiency against bank account net revenue
Measures the fully-blended cost to acquire a single net-new paying customer
kpis.dax_formula: [Blended CAC] = DIVIDE([Total Ad Spend], [Total New Customers Acquired], 0)

kpis.business_definition: Establishes long-term customer monetization potential to validate allowable acquisition costs
Measures people who clicked on the ad compared to the amount of people who viewed it
Profit generated during the data period (1 year data period)
Profit generated during the baseline period prior to scaling the marketing campaigns
kpis.dax_formula: Baseline Marketing Profit =CALCULATE(     [Marketing Profit],     DATESBETWEEN(dim_date[full_date], DATE(2025, 7, 1), DATE(2025, 12, 31)) )

kpis.business_definition: Profit generated during the period of scaling the marketing campaigns
kpis.dax_formula: Campaign Scaling Marketing Profit =CALCULATE(     [Marketing Profit],     DATESBETWEEN(dim_date[full_date], DATE(2026, 1, 1), DATE(2026, 6, 30)) )

kpis.business_definition: Profit generated by scaling ad spend compared to historical pre-scaling baselines
kpis.dax_formula: Incremental Marketing Profit =[Campaign Marketing Profit] - [Baseline Marketing Profit]

kpis.business_definition: Growth % due to marketing campaign scaling

kpis.dax_formula: [Total Active Customer Base] - [Total New Customers Acquired]
DIVIDE([Total New Customers Acquired], [Total Active Customer Base], 0)

kpis.business_definition: Percent customers returning to place orders
kpis.dax_formula: DIVIDE([Total Returning Customers], [Total Active Customer Base], 0)

business_rules.rule_description: Exclude internal employee orders (@apexgear.com) and test orders ($0 total balance or 'TEST' in order tags).
business_rules.business_justification: Prevents revenue skewing and false conversion volume in executive reports.

business_rules.rule_description: Recognize sales revenue at transaction authorization date; recognize returns on refund credit memo issuance date.
business_rules.business_justification: Aligns BI reporting directly with GAAP accounting financial ledgers.

business_rules.rule_description: Calculate Marketing Efficiency Ratio strictly against bank-settled Net Revenue, using single-platform reported revenues for tactical sub-channel insights only.
business_rules.business_justification: Eliminates multi-touch attribution over-reporting across Meta, Google, and TikTok.

ux_pages.layout_theme_notes: KPI cards highlight Net Sales, Ad Spend, MER, CAC, and Incremental Profit. Middle tier shows monthly Net Sales vs Spend trend with an MER overlay line (left) and H1 Baseline vs H2 Campaign scaling comparison (right). Bottom matrix breaks down financial and acquisition efficiency across channel groups.

Tactical acquisition diagnostic page. Top row tracks reach and engagement volume. Middle tier evaluates campaign ROAS vs spend alongside a CTR vs CPC efficiency scatter plot. Bottom matrix provides a detailed performance scorecard per campaign.

Focuses on retention economics and site conversion. Top cards monitor customer volume and acquisition mix. Visuals track monthly new vs returning customer split, segment contribution, macro funnel conversion, and a detailed segment unit-economic matrix.
